nodeReferencePolicy: graphNodeIds refer exactly to this document-local graphNodeProofs dictionary, not newly minted facts. Each node proof is stored once.
focusProducerRerun: annualNarrativeEvidence called with the packet normalized input and original AnnualClock, exact calendar/focus compared. No alternative selection algorithm.
differentInstantPolicy: Existing buildActualEvidenceGraph requires evaluation instant to match packet generatedAt, while publication requires original AnnualClock.currentDate to match generatedAt. A differing clock is rejected; no gate relaxation or silent clock replacement. Each position is still checked with its own recorded clock.
unverifiedTimePolicy: No candidate emitted. Adapter withholds when source/segment/native time verification fails.
